disposition_reason: One hundred eleven vegetable samples of 19 types from industrial areas of Haryana were analysed by AAS for ten metals; Table 2 gives mean ± SD per vegetable on a dry-weight basis.

study.design: Survey of vegetables from industrial areas with health risk assessment
study.origin: industrial areas of Haryana (NCR), India; groundwater irrigated except one Sonipat site irrigated with wastewater
study.method: Oven drying 60 °C, HNO3/H2SO4/HClO4 (5:1:1) digestion; AAS (Lab India 8000A)
study.qa: Triplicates, reagent blanks, reference standard within 5% of certified values; blank and standard every ten samples
